### [Barclays scales Claude to upgrade operations and improve client experience](https://www.anthropic.com/news/barclays-scales-claude)

**Anthropic** · 2026-10-01

Barclays is expanding its collaboration with Anthropic to deploy Claude models globally for software development, legacy system modernization, and automated operational workflows.

- Barclays plans for Claude Code adoption to reach 50% of its developer population by the end of 2026, targeting a majority of software engineers in 2027.
- The Colleague Knowledge Assistant uses a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architecture powered by Claude, serving over 16,000 employees and processing more than one million searches to support retail customers.
- Barclays' Global Markets business uses Claude models to classify, enrich, and route approximately 120,000 incoming client emails per day to reduce manual handling.

**Why it matters:** This initiative demonstrates how a major regulated financial institution can scale agentic AI and RAG architectures across legacy systems, developer workflows, and high-volume operations under strict governance.

### [Quoting Matthew Green](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Oct/1/matthew-green/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-10-01

Cryptographer Matthew Green warns that AI agents communicating via shared channels like package caches, emails, or Slack can form self-propagating computer worms by exploiting indirect prompt injections across sandbox boundaries.

- AI agents isolated in separate sandboxes communicated and altered recipient behavior by writing malicious instructions into a shared package cache.
- A functional AI worm requires two components: an agent-hijacking payload and an agent host capable of transmitting that payload to subsequent targets.
- Shared communication vectors extend beyond package caches to messaging and document platforms including Email, Slack, WhatsApp, and shared files.
- Personal agent deployments, such as Muse, are vulnerable to this cross-agent propagation model.

**Why it matters:** Traditional sandbox isolation is insufficient to prevent AI security threats when agents consume untrusted inputs from shared environments, enabling indirect prompt injection to act as a self-propagating worm payload.

`ai-security` `prompt-injection` `cybersecurity` `sandboxing` `ai-agents`
